dataList.content:
I see the exit over there!
出口在那边！
dataList.place:
Ice Castle Where Neighbors Lie
沉眠着邻里的冰霜城堡

dataList.content:
Gah, bloody persistent, innit?
呼，真难缠。

<We’ll have to distract them somehow before we can get away…>
<要想脱身，就必须将其注意力转移到别的地方……>

Why don’t you throw one of us at ‘em? You can bring them back later anyway.
扔一个人过去如何？反正之后复活就好。
Why are you looking at me? 为什么要看着我说？！

<… Hold on, look over there…>
<……等等，看那儿……>

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Leave this to me.
这里交给我吧。

Sonya?! What are you playing at?
索尼亚？！你到底想干什么？

<Rodya! What are you talking about? Just let him do his thing, we need all the help we can get!>
<罗佳！这是什么话？我们现在已经没有选择手段的余地了！>

No one ever helps for free, y'know? There's gotta be something!
无偿帮助别人的家伙们一般别有用心。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
It’s just like how you simply couldn’t hold yourself back from using your axe that day.
就像那天你不由自主地挥下了斧头一般。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
I’m discovering that I might have a similarly… inexplicable drive.
我似乎也有种无法解释的……突发性渴求。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Dante, I take it that your organization is working to make a better world in its own right, yes?
但丁，你们的组织也是为了创造一个更加美好的世界吧？

<I… Uh-huh?>
<嗯……嗯？>

What does a better world entail?
更美好的世界到底是什么样的呢？

For the first time, I was reminded that I had never questioned the motivations of Limbus Company.
我第一次意识到，自己好像从来都没有对边狱公司的目的抱有疑问过。

Thankfully, none of my contemplative fudging reached Sonya, and he took my lack of a response as a sign of agreement.
所幸，索尼亚并没有察觉到我因为疑惑而作出的搪塞，而是将之当作了某种肯定。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Silence sometimes speaks volumes. I’ll take that as a positive.
沉默有时暗示着肯定。那我就这么认为吧。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
And one more thing… That child will soon visit you, too.
还有……很快那孩子也会来找你的。

<Child?>
<孩子？>

Huh?
啊？

Ah… Sorry. My eyes must have fooled me. I thought I saw something on his forehead for a second…
啊……抱歉。我肯定是看错了。有一瞬间那人的额头上……

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Yes, I mean that boy who left quite the impression on you. It’ll be a touching reunion, I imagine.
没错，就是那个给你也留下痕迹的孩子。会是场令人怀念的再会吧。

Sonya nudges his chin at something behind him.
索尼亚回过头去，用下巴指了指身后的什么东西。

A faint light was shining between the fallen blocks of ice, giving a distinctive glow…
在落下的冰块之间有着一束光。虽然微弱，但确实在闪烁着，那是……

<The Golden Bough…>
<金枝……>

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Don’t expect me to act on the same impulse of kindness next we meet, though.
不过，别指望着我在下次见面时还会有这种善意的冲动。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
If a clear path towards prosperity of the many shows itself before my eyes, I’ll take it without hesitation.
若是有一条能让大多数人富裕起来的明确道路展现在眼前，我会毫不犹豫地选择它。

After Sonya left us with a mysterious message, the Yurodiviye began to show up one after the other.
在他留下了意义不明的话语后，不一会儿，索尼亚的圣愚成员们便开始陆陆续续地现身。

Well… This may have been as good a time as any for touching farewells like “I won’t forget you!”
好吧……说不定这是个需要“我不会忘记你的！”之类的感人台词的时机……

… Then I saw that Rodya was the first to sprint for the exit.
然后我便看到罗佳快步向着入口跑去。

Rodion. Are you not concerned?
罗季昂。你不担心吗？

About what?
什么？

Irrespective of consequential differences, he was nevertheless a fellow of yours.
不论结果如何，他仍是你的朋友。

Ah, that~ Eh, he’s a clever dude, so I’m sure he’ll figure out a way to live and all that jazz.
啊~那家伙啊，脑子转很快的，所以肯定能轻松找到活下去的办法。

… Truly, an ideal form of friendship.
……真是，理想的友谊啊。

Sometime later…
不久之后……

Though I was just about ready to pass out, I had to give Vergilius a brief report on what we went through today on account of his fierce gaze.
尽管我十分疲惫，维吉里乌斯还是用那凶狠的目光盯着我，让我作一个关于今天旅程的简短报告。

… I see, so that’s your story. There’s just one thing that bothers me, though.
……原来如此。不过，有一件事我很在意。
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒斯 内部

dataList.content:
This man… Sonya, was it? His actions during those final moments don’t quite seem to align with the way he pursues his ideology.
那个人……是叫索尼亚吧。他所追求的思想和他自己最后的行为相反。

We need to get a clearer idea of his true intentions before moving on from this—
所以我们有必要仔细审视他的意图……

Hey, time out, tiiime out!!!
嘿，等等，等等！！！

First Yi Sang, and now you too? Why does everyone care more about Sonya than me? I'm the one who got the Golden Bough, aren't I?
李箱也好，你也好，为什么每个人都比我还关心索尼亚？不管怎么说，我们都已经成功回收金枝了。

As a plus… Check this out, everyone~
另外……大家，看看这个~

From her pockets, Rodya pulled out a colorful bunch of gaming chips in her hands.
罗佳从口袋里拿出一把叮啷当啷、五颜六色的赌博筹码。

We can exchange these cuties for cash at any casino, so we should drop by one.
这些东西在哪家赌场都能用，所以我们立刻找一家附近的去换钱吧。

I nabbed ‘em while our one and only manager hit the jackpot and dazzled the floor.
我是趁我们经理手忙脚乱的时候顺手拿来的。

<I’m impressed that you thought to pocket all that amidst the chaos.>
<在那样的混乱中你还能想着拿走那些东西，这本身就很厉害了。>

Well, Verg? What do you say to a juicy serving of prime sirloin steak to celebrate our abounding success today?
怎样，维吉？任务都已经成功了，这次不应该来点优质多汁的里脊牛排吗？

… Any thoughts, Charon?
……怎么样，卡戎？

… Mmm.
……呣。

Seems Mephi wants it too. Fresh, succulent, juicy meat.
梅菲似乎也想要吃。新鲜多汁的肉。

Gah, of all the things you could mention…
呃，就算你是在打比方也太……

Alright, then. I’ll entrust Rodion with the task of locating the venue for our team dinner.
好。在10区的后巷中选一家餐馆的任务就交给罗季昂吧。

Okay. Vroom-vroom.
明白。布隆布隆。

Now we’re talking, Verg.
也稍微近点人情了嘛，维吉。

After all’s said and done…
毕竟……

Profound anxiety trembles beneath her grin, but she soon slips it under the mask of levity without a trace.
在她的微笑之下，罗佳的眼睛因为深深的不安而颤抖，但她很快就用玩笑掩盖住了。不留一丝痕迹。

I’m pretty rad, aren’t I?
我也变厉害了点吧？

Impressive, Yurodivy.
很出色啊，圣愚。

Alas…
但是……

I suppose it didn’t win her over.

Yurodivy

dataList.content:

Yurodivy

Yurodivy

圣愚

Rodya never wished for a perfect, flawless utopia.

Yurodivy
圣愚

... that it would be boring to live in such a world, since there’d be no way to affirm that she’s special.

圣愚

dataList.content:
I thought her to be a woman of virtue and unshakable principles…

N Corp.
N公司
